prompt: Create one original fine-art image for a source-led reading of Perpetua's REPORTED VISION, not a historical reconstruction. Wide landscape composition, 3:2. Monumental charcoal, scratched ink and muted mineral washes on rough paper: an impossible empty oval arena rising in nested dark indigo arcs, open midnight sky. In the center, two overlapping human shadows, spare gestural marks of a body in motion that can be read as both feminine and masculine, no identifiable faces, no ethnic coding, no nudity detail, no wounds, no beasts, no weapons. The human mark is small within the space, but perceptible. A broken slanting light like a threshold on the right, a small branch bearing gold round fruit in the lower left; the branch is secondary, the spatial encounter and shifting shadow carry the image. Expressive strange dream space, visibly hand-worked grain, deep Prussian blue, bone white, restrained copper gold. Intense quiet, not triumphant or motivational. Avoid photorealism, videogame scenery, halos, church iconography, inscriptions or any text, symmetrical graphic diagrams, generic celestial clouds. There must be generous dark space in the lower right so separately rendered source text can remain legible. This is disclosed AI-generated interpretive artwork inspired by Passion section 10; it must never resemble archaeological evidence or an authentic ancient artifact.
